response_text:
To solve  

\[
-3x^{2}+5x-4=2x-5
\]

bring all terms to one side:

\[
-3x^{2}+5x-4-2x+5=0 \;\Longrightarrow\; -3x^{2}+3x+1=0.
\]

Multiply by \(-1\) to make the leading coefficient positive:

\[
3x^{2}-3x-1=0.
\]

Use the quadratic formula \(x=\dfrac{-b\pm\sqrt{b^{2}-4ac}}{2a}\) with  
\(a=3,\; b=-3,\; c=-1\):

\[
x=\frac{-(-3)\pm\sqrt{(-3)^{2}-4(3)(-1)}}{2(3)}
   =\frac{3\pm\sqrt{9+12}}{6}
   =\frac{3\pm\sqrt{21}}{6}.
\]

So the solutions are

\[
\boxed{\,x=\dfrac{3+\sqrt{21}}{6}\quad\text{or}\quad x=\dfrac{3-\sqrt{21}}{6}\,}
\]

(Equivalently, \(x=\tfrac12 \pm \tfrac{\sqrt{21}}{6}\).)

Numerically,  
\(x \approx 1.264\) or \(x \approx -0.264\).
